name: Stack

sendToBackOnClick.description: Click, Enter or Space on the top card also sends it to the back.

dragThreshold.description: Drag distance in px past which the top card flies to the back.

rotateRange.description: Maximum seeded rotation of a lower card, in degrees.

offset.description: Vertical offset per depth level, in px.

spring.description: Spring used for the fly-to-back and spring-back animations.

seed.description: Seed for each lower card's offset/rotation, so the pile is identical on every load.

visible.description: Cards shown in the pile before they are hidden.

a11y: The host is role="list" and each card role="listitem"; only the top card is in the tab order, with role="button" and an aria-label ("Send card to back", overridable with data-genui-stack-label).
After a reorder, focus moves to the new top card and a visually-hidden aria-live="polite" region announces which card it is.
Reordering moves DOM nodes rather than repainting, so reading order always matches the pile order.
Card content is real text, not an image or canvas.
